data.name: Gloss_PassedOn
data.value: money handed from one module to the next. The thicker the line, the more money.

data.name: Gloss_IntoBucket
data.value: money that ends in one of the bar's buckets, its line running into it, or that comes back out of a bucket, its line then ending in an arrowhead. The thicker the line, the more money.

data.name: Gloss_Pocket
data.value: what reaches you, in gold: one line down your column into your pocket, saying after each line joining it what has reached you so far.

data.name: Gloss_TaxBase
data.value: what changes the amount a tax is worked out on without moving money, a benefit taxed with the pay, what Corporate tax adds back, the marital quotient. Drawn for the module you choose, each line saying its amount.

data.name: Gloss_Condition
data.value: a condition one module sets on another. Drawn for the module you choose, its rule and whether it holds listed beside the card; a box says it only where it is lost.
